motion.title: Design & Motion
motion.timing.title: Asymmetric timing
motion.timing.desc: Enter animations are slightly longer than exits. New content takes time to land; dismissed content leaves quickly.
motion.easing.title: Emphasized easing
motion.easing.desc: Decelerate on enter, accelerate on exit. No generic ease curves.
motion.spring.title: Spring-based modals
motion.spring.desc: Dialogs use physically-modeled spring animations for a natural, responsive feel.
motion.tokens.title: Motion tokens
motion.tokens.desc: All durations and curves are CSS custom properties, ensuring a unified rhythm across 12+ components.

rebrand.body: Motrix Next is now Rayburst, and its browser extension is now Rayburst Connect. A fresh desktop installation is recommended. Settings, tasks and history are not imported. In-app updates may leave both apps installed or retain old shortcuts.
connect.description: Discover HLS/DASH streams and media files in Sniffer, the browser sidebar, or the full-page workspace. Send selected resources to Rayburst.
features.media.description: Choose video, audio and subtitles, record live streams, and save to MP4 or MKV. DRM-protected media is not supported.
engine.description: {aria2Next} is the open-source download engine behind Rayburst. It supports HTTP, HTTPS, SFTP, ED2K and BitTorrent, with a command-line interface and JSON-RPC.
dl.note: Latest stable release. Older releases may use the previous name.
hero.description: A desktop download manager for files, torrents and streams.

connect.handoff: Send browser downloads to Rayburst automatically, set per-site rules, and manage tasks from the popup.
connect.preview: Preview media before downloading and choose video, audio and subtitle tracks. Requires the Rayburst desktop app.
connect.artwork.alt: Rayburst Connect sends browser downloads to the Rayburst desktop app
